facts.fact: Raghu's clerk wrote eleven of Dhanu's ewes' names before understanding Dhanu was giving only ewes.
Gauri put Mini on the pony to her sister's before Raghu's men reached the huts (consistent with F642).
Ila has worked toward the Chief Surveyor's seal since she was nineteen; telling Kunal the letter breaks her archive oath and the queen's order and may cost her the seal.
Kunal promises Gauri the first pair of spring lambs born at Ewe's Rest; the rope hums level, so it is a bound promise.
Kunal now reads Raghu's whitened fingertips on the shore (his lie to Pasang that Dhanu had gone home, per F584) as proof Dhanu was already dead.
